name: Hurkyl
description: A woman of the College of Lat-Nam whose meditation made one a conduit for the soul of the land.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary" by Miguel Lopez, Jeff Grubb. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla studies Hurkyl's writings and learns to control her magic through a stone from Kroog.
timeline.quote: Kayla's new nightly practice followed the precepts of Hurkyl's meditative techniques as laid out in the book.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.
